notes.title: Language filter added
notes.notes: [p]By default, Lavender Field uses a language filter to soften strong expressions. Players may disable it in the settings if they prefer the original tone. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554585/a4b0bde399fc0e9f606adb184677ab17fbcc20f9.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Developer Diary:
notes.notes: [list][*][p]The game is entering its final stage of development.[/p][/*][*][p]Localization into several languages has begun.[/p][/*][*][p]The inventory system has been updated compared to the demo version.[/p][/*][*][p]New gameplay features have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]The story of the first chapter has been expanded and deepened.[/p][/*][*][p]An updated demo will be released after the full game's launch.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]
